title: Cylindrical temporal pattern hashing — pattern through time
summary: dev10 extends polar pattern identity into time: event progress is angle, normalized per-channel state is radius, and event time is height. Adjacent points create 3-D bearing/elevation/turn signatures, multi-channel state stays vector-valued, and largest declared structural/temporal disagreement dominates finer differences.
authority: Executable dev10 source/tests and the self-generating cylindrical market demo are authoritative. The demo is illustrative synthetic market data; it proves semantics, not investment or causal claims.
invariants: Time is an independent height coordinate, not a synonym for event index.
The cylinder is circular in its pattern plane but open in time; no synthetic last-to-first temporal segment is created.
Per-channel state is normalized independently and retained independently; multi-channel temporal patterns are not pre-collapsed into one scalar.
A temporal segment retains planar bearing, vertical elevation and 3-D turn evidence in addition to radial shape and time gaps.
Time-shift and time-scale invariance are explicit policy. Time-scale invariance implies time-shift invariance; contradictory policy fails closed.
Global time scaling may be erased when declared, but local timing fluctuation must remain visible in time-gap/elevation/turn evidence.
Temporal pattern distance is significance ordered largest-first and reports the dominant discrepancy kind/channel.
MLTemporalPatternIndex is a driveable historical object; index policy changes belong on retained branches.
Temporal pattern recurrence is evidence for further domain analysis, not a cryptanalytic, causal or investment conclusion.
procedure: Represent events with MLTemporalPatternSeries using strictly increasing event times, stable channel names and explicit channel weights.
Create MLTemporalPatternPolicy with angular/radial/time/bearing/elevation/turn resolution and significance weights.
Use MLCylindricalTemporalPatternSchema to encode and inspect points/vectors; bearing is circular-plane direction and elevation is temporal pitch.
Enable timeScaleInvariant only when overall faster/slower replay should remain the same pattern; local event delays still remain evidence.
Use MLTemporalPatternCorpus / MLTemporalPatternIndex for nearest pattern-through-time retrieval with stable sample ids.
Inspect MLTemporalPatternDifference dominantKind/dominantChannel plus radius/time/bearing/elevation/turn maxima rather than relying on total distance alone.
Run examples/cylindrical_market_pattern_demo.rex. Confirm A/C exact economic-time twin, A/D local timing separation and A/B nominal-price lookalike separation through auxiliary channels.
For market/crypto/audio/camera/sensor uses, calibrate channel significance on held-out evidence and keep domain conclusions separate from match evidence.

provenance.claim: Executable cylindrical temporal pattern schema, 3-D direction evidence, significance difference and historical index.
